instruction.text: Choose the correct spelling of the word that matches the picture.

hint.text: Some words are spelt with 'ei', 'eigh' and 'ey' to make an 'ay' sound when the word is pronounced.
hint.sound: Some words are spelt with e i, e i g h and e y to make an ay sound when the word is pronounced.

end.text: A 'vein' is a blood vessel that carries blood to the heart. There is also a word spelt 'vain', which means to be obsessed with one’s appearance or achievements.
end.sound: A vain is a blood vessel that carries blood to the heart. There is also a word spelt vain which means to be obsessed with ones appearence or achievements.

end.text: 'Weight' describes how heavy something is. There is also a word spelt 'wait', which is expecting something to happen.
'Eight' is the spelling of the number. There is also a word spelt 'ate', which is the past tense of 'eat'.
'Reign' is the time period of having royal power as a king or queen. There are also words spelt 'rain' and 'rein', which describe wet weather and straps to control riding an animal.
end.sound: 'Reign' is the time period of having royal power as a king or queen. There are also words spelt 'reign' and 'reign', which describe wet weather and straps to control riding an animal.

end.text: 'Prey' describes an animal that a predator eats. There is also a word spelt 'pray' which is a religious act of thanksgiving or forgiveness.
